CVE-2026-132165.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.22, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.22, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.13.

CVE-2026-133275.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an arbitrary file upload attack due to insufficient file type validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to upload arbitrary files to the target system. This is MTLVULN-1861.

CVE-2026-136716.description: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.23, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.23, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.14.

A client may negotiate ca_maxresponsesize_cached down to NFSD_MIN_HDR_SEQ_SZ, and nfsd4_alloc_slot() then gives every slot a zero-length sl_data[]. A COMPOUND tag can fill that narrowed buffer until it holds the SEQUENCE opcode but not the status word that…
